# Feature request

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](feature_request.vi.md)

## Goal
What user or engineering problem should this solve?

## Proposed scope
Describe the smallest useful change and the files/interfaces it would affect.

## Qualification impact
State whether this changes Kaggle hardware assumptions, runtime settings, benchmark semantics, evidence, or public claims.

## Validation
Describe how the change can be tested without overwriting retained authority.

Do not include credentials, private data, model weights, or personal voice recordings.
